title: 8. Vacancy in the Office of President

blocks.content:
A vacancy may occur due to:
• Expiry of term
• Resignation
• Removal
• Death
The Vice President acts as President until a new election is held.

items: Who acts as President in case of a vacancy? The Vice President.
What are the four circumstances causing a vacancy in the President's office? Expiry of term, Resignation, Removal, and Death.
Duration of Vice President acting as President: Until a new election is held.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A vacancy in the Office of President may occur due to four reasons: Expiry of term, Resignation, Removal, or Death.
When a vacancy occurs, the Vice President assumes the role and acts as President.
The Vice President performs the duties of the President until a new election is held.
